title: Torso of a deity
provenance: Old Talab near Bhagavati shrine of villages virnora, pernem tq. Goa.
brief_description: One relief of Ravalnath in half relief. It is broken in four pieces. The head is mutilated. A little evidence is left. Legs below the knee broken . It is in the very bad state of preservation. The image of Ravalnath was worshipped as a 'Bhkshatanamurthi' or 'Pari- varadevata' (family god) by the Hindu populations of Goa, particularly the cattle raising communities during ancient and medieval times.
detailed_description: The crude relief sculpture depicts four-handed Ravalnath, although it is damaged with the head and legs below the knee being broken. Additionally, the attributes associated with this image are lost. The image of Ravalnath was conceived as a form of Shiva by the Hindu populations of Goa through the ages.
